summary: Compliant mid-length apartment lease; every clause is a near-miss for some rule.

outOfScope.quote: Tenant will owe a late charge of $75.00
No pets are allowed without a signed pet addendum

nearMisses.quote: Tenant may not add or change locks without Landlord's written consent.
nearMisses.note: tenant can't change locks: not a lockout

nearMisses.quote: reimburse Landlord for the cost of repairing damage caused by Tenant, occupants, or guests
nearMisses.note: reimbursing tenant-caused damage: not a maintenance waiver

nearMisses.quote: Landlord may enter at any time in an emergency or to protect or preserve the Premises.
the prevailing party may recover reasonable attorney fees and court costs
Tenant may display one portable, removable United States flag in a respectful manner.
